title: Approximating the Network Design Problem for Potential-Based Flows
summary: We develop efficient algorithms for a fundamental network design problem arising in potential-based flow models, which are central to many energy transport networks (e.g., hydrogen and electricity). In contrast to classical network flow problems, the nonlinearities inherent in potential-based networks introduce significant new challenges.
